name: Polyploid Small-Variant Genotyping Benchmark
description: A benchmark that evaluates small-variant genotyping methods specifically in polyploid genomes to assess accuracy and limitations.
evaluation_method: precision / recall and F1 (variant-level) plus genotype concordance / genotype-level accuracy
typical_sota_score: varies widely by ploidy and dataset; often reported in the range 50–95%
reputation: A specialized benchmark respected in the genomics community for assessing polyploid genotyping but less widely used than standard diploid benchmarks.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark requiring real sequencing data and high-quality truth sets; limited gold-standard truth for many polyploid organisms, computationally intensive, and results can be sensitive to sequencing depth and caller parameterization.
